findings.area: active Village mapper receipt direction integrity
findings.detail: The active requirements-mapper-village-guardian-batch-b-v6 receipt declares the global provenance-direction digest as a 65-character value with one extra '7' in both provenance_direction.sha256 and input_hashes.provenance_direction. The actual committed direction digest is the 64-character 4d1ec24e...da9ac value. V12 pins the receipt's outer bytes but never validates these nested direction bindings, so its receipt selector is a false green for a non-waived receipt-integrity control.

findings.area: V12 fixture input completeness and reproducibility
findings.detail: V12 inherits BatchBNegativeFixtureContract.test_archer_fixture_refutations_rederive_from_source_boundaries from batch-b-truth-tests-v6.py. That test reads archers-revenge-claim-ledger-batch-b.json at runtime to resolve AR-B2-FIX-004's AR-B-HIST-RESPONSIVE-001 anchor, but the predecessor ledger is absent from V12 receipt input_hashes. findings.area: Archer's Revenge package completeness against track focus requirements
findings.detail: The active Archer V3 ledger contains only 20 copy, binary-presence, transition, and source-surface claims. Its own reconciliation says historical route/implementation claims remain in the V1 ledger, while the active V4 blueprint explicitly reports no identity claim, no route claim, no current scene proposition, unknown responsive behavior, and unknown asset usage. Reachable historical logic/config/component/test blobs contain additional game-specific targeting, shield/projectile, enemy-fire, health, combat, configuration, route, responsive, and test evidence required by spec.md lines 9-15. Marking those source-backed requirements unknown does not satisfy the required complete per-game package, even though the 20 selected claim envelopes are exact.
findings.required_remediation: Publish an additive Archer collector package that atomically covers every required reachable historical mechanic/configuration/route/test/responsive/asset-use fact or gives an exact bounded absence for each category, update the mapper and reports to reference the complete active population, rerun denominator/source/fixture gates, and obtain a fresh review.
